title: Settings
subServer: How TERPGRID looks and behaves – synced with your account.
subLocal: How TERPGRID looks and behaves – stored in this browser.
currencyHint: For expenses, collection and calculators. Amounts are not converted.
overviewHint: You set the order and visibility of sections directly on the overview via “Customize”.
harmHint: Shows factual notes in the journal (e.g. delayed effect of edibles).
labNoticeHint: Show the hidden safety notice again.
p1: • Self-hosted · private data protected: data is stored on your TERPGRID server, encrypted there with AES-256-GCM (not end-to-end encryption).
p2: • No analytics or tracking services. Personal data is never sent to strain data providers; Discover runs through your server.
p3: • Photos are re-encoded on import; embedded metadata such as GPS is removed.
p4: • During the session, a working copy is stored unencrypted in this browser; beyond the session only with offline use turned on. Details in the privacy center.
l1: • Local mode: personal data only in this browser · online strain data from external sources.
l2: • No accounts, no analytics or tracking services. Grow logs, photos, journal and collection are never sent to providers.
l3: • Network access is restricted by Content Security Policy to StrainAPI and CannaLib – and only when you use Discover.
l5: • Data is not encrypted and not synced – back up with a backup file.
appSub: Installation, updates and display on this device
noSw: Update check not possible here (no service worker active).
motionHint: Turns off animations and transitions on this device – in addition to the system setting.
noPush: There are deliberately no push notifications to the device: they would involve the browser vendors' external push services. News appears in the app (bell).
strainapiHint: Off: Discover only shows locally cached entries. Only search terms and strain IDs are sent.
cannalibHint: Only on explicit click; the strain name is transmitted. Anonymous quota of the source approx. 20/h.
cacheHint: Discarded after 7 days at the latest, not included in the backup.
aboutText: Version {v} · database schema v{db}. An information tool for personal documentation and harm reduction – not medical or legal advice. Laws on possession, cultivation and use differ from country to country.
